title: RVD & Sabu turn rivalry into tag-team gold
summary: Former rivals combine their aerial offense under Bill Alfonso’s management. Their team brings spectacular double-team wrestling into championship matches against both domestic and visiting opponents.

chapters.title: Van Dam and Sabu win the tag titles
chapters.result: Van Dam and Sabu defeat Storm and Candido for the championships.
chapters.context: The former opponents now hold ECW’s team prize together.

chapters.title: The champions face FMW’s challengers
chapters.result: Van Dam and Sabu defeat Hayabusa and Shinzaki to retain.
chapters.context: The international title defense showcases the team’s chemistry and ECW’s connection to Japanese wrestling.
